lines.zh: 我跑一段就停下来等你。
lines.en: I run ahead, then stop to wait.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀半张着，像在平衡。
lines.en: My wings stay half open for balance.

lines.zh: 我从砖缝上走过，一步一步。
lines.en: I cross the brick seams, step by step.

lines.zh: 我在草地上跑，草比我还高。
lines.en: I run in grass taller than I am.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，跑成一个小圈。
lines.en: I circle you in a small loop.

lines.zh: 我跳上木箱，再从另一边下去。
lines.en: I hop on a crate and down the far side.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，爪子抓得牢。
lines.en: I walk steadily, claws finding grip.
Two steps, then a glance at the sky.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾巴跑，尾巴扫过草。
lines.en: I run with my tail sweeping the grass.

lines.zh: 我挤过栅栏的缝，正好够宽。
lines.en: I squeeze through a fence gap, just wide enough.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，隔了一小段距离。
lines.en: I follow a short way behind you.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上，暖烘烘的。
lines.en: I sprawl on a stone, warm.

lines.zh: 我的花纹和别的小龙不一样。
lines.en: My markings aren't like other tiny dragons'.

lines.zh: 我在看自己尾巴的影子。
lines.en: I'm watching my tail's shadow.

lines.zh: 我伸爪子去够一片落叶。
lines.en: I reach a paw for a falling leaf.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在爪子上，歇着。
lines.en: I rest my head on my paws.
I hear wind over the tower top.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，很没形象。
lines.en: I yawn, with no dignity at all.

lines.zh: 我数着地上的砖，数到七就忘。
lines.en: I count floor tiles and lose count at seven.
Light passes through my wing membrane.
I lick my nose; it's wet.

lines.zh: 我记得那个箱子里的味道。
lines.en: I remember the smell inside that chest.
I curl into a ring.

lines.zh: 我跳到你靴子上，站得高。
lines.en: I hop on your boot to stand taller.
I want to climb onto your shoulder.
You reach out, and I lean in.

lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀追你的靴子。
lines.en: I flap after your boots on stubby wings.
I circle to your other side.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the warmth of your palm.

lines.zh: 我站起来，前爪搭在你腿上。
lines.en: I stand, forepaws on your leg.
Your shadow is enough shade for me.

lines.zh: 我轻轻碰了碰你的手指。
lines.en: I touch your fingers lightly.
I call once, and you turn.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼睛，里面有我。
lines.en: I look in your eyes; I'm in them.
Will you lift me up?
I don't like being held too tight.

lines.zh: 你蹲着，我就坐在你膝上。
lines.en: You crouch, and I sit on your knee.
The pain makes me hop in place.

lines.zh: 我的角磕了一下，钝钝的。
lines.en: My horn took a knock; it throbs.
I shrink behind you.
My wings won't fold right.
I whimper softly, feeling wronged.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打歪了半边。
lines.en: That knocked one side of me askew.
I shake, my scales clicking.
I lick my paw; there's a little blood.
I'm still standing; don't worry.
I back off two steps and return.
Raw chicken smells best.
I smell it; it's in your hand.
I jump for it; almost.
Set the meat down; I'll eat it myself.
I sit and wait without a paw moving.
That smell won't let me sit still.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼睛跟着你的手。
lines.en: I look up, eyes on your hand.
One more bite, just one.
I push my head into your palm.
I snatch it and carry it two steps off.

lines.zh: 我撞到你脚上，坐下去了。
lines.en: I bump your foot and sit down.

lines.zh: 你差点踩到我，我滚开了。
lines.en: You nearly stepped on me; I rolled clear.
I'm so small; watch your feet.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的角顶疼了。
lines.en: We bump, and my horn stings.
I squeeze between your legs.
One knock and I roll a full turn.
I stand against you, out of the way.
After the bump I shake myself off.
We both pause a moment.

lines.zh: 她是从另一个箱子里孵出来的。
lines.en: She hatched from another chest.

lines.zh: 我们的花纹不一样，正好。
lines.en: Our markings differ; that's good.

lines.zh: 我们一起在石头上晒太阳。
lines.en: We sun ourselves on the same stone.

lines.zh: 我们分一块肉，抢了两下。
lines.en: We split a piece of meat after two tussles.
She's a little faster than I am.
We lie side by side, looking out.

lines.zh: 她睡的时候会打小火苗。
lines.en: She sputters small flames in her sleep.

lines.zh: 我们的窝在一堆旧布上。
lines.en: Our nest is a heap of old cloth.
She calls once, and I go.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块闪亮的碎玻璃。
lines.en: I pick up a shiny piece of glass.
I pick up your quill.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的面包屑吃了。
lines.en: I eat the fallen breadcrumbs.
I hug a pebble; it's round.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的钥匙拖走了。
lines.en: I drag away the key you dropped.
I pick up a wood chip and chew it.

lines.zh: 我从土里扒出一枚硬币。
lines.en: I dig a coin out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片花瓣，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a petal and sniff it.
I roll the thread ball to your feet.

lines.zh: 我叼起掉在地上的帽子。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen hat.
I spread my wings and call first.
This one smells awful.
I leap down from your shoulder.
Fire gathers in my throat.

lines.zh: 它踩坏了我晒太阳的石头。
lines.en: It crushed the stone I sun on.
I put myself between you and it.
I'm smaller, but faster.
I fix on its knees.

lines.zh: 它蹲的那块砖我记下了。
lines.en: I've marked the tile it crouches on.
I breathe fire on three.
It backs off; I take a step.
There's a spark glowing in my throat.
Master, stand back a little.
My scales are standing up.
I run small circles around it.
It raises a hand; I'm already below.

lines.zh: 我咬它的脚趾，咬完就跑。
lines.en: I bite its toe and run.
It stomps and only hits dirt.
I hold my fire until it's closer.
It starts panting, and I speed up.
I run along its shadow.
It can't turn here; too narrow.
I hop on a stone for the high ground.
It throws something; it misses.
I count its steps, waiting for a gap.
I want to bite the hand holding the weapon.
It backs to the wall; I follow.
My throat is burning hot.
It's rattled; now.

lines.zh: 我绕到它够不到的那边。
lines.en: I move to the side it can't reach.
It lunges and catches empty air.

lines.zh: 我等着它抬手，那一瞬最空。
lines.en: I wait for its raised arm; that's the gap.
I breathe fire taller than myself.
The flame strikes its foot.
I butt its knee.

lines.zh: 我跳上它的手臂，抓了两下。
lines.en: I leap on its arm and claw twice.

lines.zh: 它一抖，我掉下来又站起。
lines.en: It shakes me off; I land and rise.
That bite went deep.
I circle the side and breathe again.
It guards its face; I bite its leg.
I roll clear as fire still burns.
I claw its belt and pull down.
I gulp air and breathe again.
Its armor is scorched black.
I spent all my strength there.
I run back to my master's feet.
The egg sat in fire for ten minutes.
The shell splits; I poke my head out first.
I'm turned up out of a chest.
It's warmer here than in the temple.
I spread my wings for the first time.
My scales are still damp.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，壳片掉了一地。
lines.en: I shake, and shell pieces fall.
The fire feels too good; I don't want to move.
Someone's coming; I look up.
My call is very quiet.
This place is so big.
I smell lava.
I hop out of the ash and run two steps.
Sunlight lands on my scales.
First I'll find somewhere to hide.
Bricks, fire, and a person.
My tail is still curled.
I hear steps, light ones.
Fire is familiar, but this really burns.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，尾巴先着地。
lines.en: I fall and land on my tail first.
I flail, wings soaked through.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我滚出去好远。
lines.en: A boom, and I roll far away.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的角，吓我一跳。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my horn and startles me.
A force wraps my legs.
I'm too hungry to breathe fire.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我什么也看不见。
lines.en: A flash, and I can't see anything.

lines.zh: 我掉进黑里，找不到地面。
lines.en: I fall into black and find no ground.
